EXTRACTION.mechanism_description: Deterministic reducer in src/rakl/narrative_reducer.py implements: (1) stopword-filtered content tokens (length>=3) as vocabulary; (2) top 12 tokens by frequency as roles (alphabetical tie-break); (3) within-sentence consecutive role co-occurrence (window<=4 tokens) as relations; (4) negation/contrast markers emit obstructions.
deficits: No dependency parsing or syntactic structure
No entity recognition or typing
No relation typing (all relations are undirected co-occurrence)
No role hierarchy (flat 12-token limit)
No semantic similarity or word sense disambiguation
Negation detection is crude (presence of contrast marker + >=2 roles)
Misses cross-sentence relations
No causal or process structure extraction
EXTRACTION.interpretation: The witness performed WORSE than a simple band metadata control (which just uses dataset-author 'near'/'far' labels). This indicates the extraction mechanism captures less useful signal than the surface annotation. The sparse flat extraction (12 roles, local co-occurrence) is insufficient for scientific analogy.

ABSTRACTION.mechanism_description: The reducer has NO abstraction stage. It directly outputs a flat SupportStructure with atoms (roles) and edges (relations). There is no intermediate concept construction, no hierarchical abstraction, no causal/process abstraction.
deficits: No abstraction hierarchy (no multi-granularity levels)
No intermediate concepts or roles
No process abstraction (events, states, transitions)
No causal relation extraction
No domain abstraction or ontological mapping
ABSTRACTION.evidence_from_source: narrative_reducer.py lines 61-117 show direct construction of SupportStructure from extracted tokens. No intermediate abstraction layer exists.
ABSTRACTION.interpretation: ARN reducer is a surface lexical matching system, not a structural abstraction system. The negative confirms that surface features alone cannot capture scientific analogy structure.

MAPPING.mechanism_description: Mapping is coverage-based: coverage_ratio = (|covered_roles| + 2*|covered_relations|) / (|required_roles| + 2*|required_relations|). Decision: ACCEPT if coverage_ratio >= theta_w (0.1), else REJECT. No partial credit, no role typing, no relation semantics.
deficits: No role typing or semantic compatibility
No relation semantics (all relations have same weight)
No partial mapping credit (binary accept/reject)
No cross-level mapping (no levels to map between)
No structural similarity beyond coverage
Weight 2x for relations is arbitrary, not empirically justified
MAPPING.interpretation: The coverage-based mapping failed to beat even a simple band control. This indicates that simple structural coverage is insufficient for scientific analogy mapping. More sophisticated mapping (e.g., typed role compatibility, relation semantics, partial credit) is needed.

TYPED_LICENCE.mechanism_description: ARN reducer has NO typed licence mechanism. There is no applicability condition, no scope restriction, no boundary/QoI statement, no preserved/non-preserved relation classification.
deficits: No applicability mechanism (when is analogy valid?)
No scope restriction (what aspects of source apply?)
No boundary/QoI statement (what is being compared?)
No preserved vs non-preserved relation classification
No typed licence output (only binary ACCEPT/REJECT)
TYPED_LICENCE.evidence_from_protocol: PROTOCOL.json arm definition shows witness returns only decision (ACCEPT/REJECT) + coverage_ratio. No applicability fields.
TYPED_LICENCE.interpretation: ARN reducer cannot express WHEN an analogy is valid, WHAT aspects transfer, or WHERE the boundary lies. This is a fundamental gap compared to ORION-style applicability witnesses.

ABSTENTION.mechanism_description: CANNOT_CHECK is emitted ONLY when either side has <2 roles or 0 relations (insufficient extraction evidence). No abstention on uncertain mappings, missing decisive evidence, or scope violations.
deficits: No abstention on low-confidence mappings
No abstention on missing decisive evidence
No abstention on scope violations
No abstention on uncertain applicability
Binary forced choice (ACCEPT/REJECT) even when unclear
ABSTENTION.interpretation: Despite poor performance (worse than control), witness never abstained (0.0% CANNOT_CHECK). The reducer is forced to make binary decisions even when evidence is insufficient. A principled abstention mechanism would have prevented many false accepts.

root_cause_synthesis.root_cause_statement: ARN reducer is a deterministic surface lexical matching system with (1) sparse flat extraction (12 roles, local co-occurrence), (2) no abstraction hierarchy, (3) no applicability reasoning, and (4) no principled abstention. The witness advantage CI [-0.0498, +0.0162] fails to clear MDE 0.05, and witness performed WORSE than a simple band control (0.489 vs 0.506). This confirms that shallow bag-of-features extraction is insufficient for scientific analogy decisions.
implications_for_successors: Successor must have richer extraction (dependency parsing, entity typing, relation typing)
Successor must have abstraction hierarchy (multi-granularity levels)
Successor must have typed licence mechanism (applicability, scope, boundary/QoI)
Successor must have principled abstention (uncertain mappings, missing evidence)

ARN_REDUCER.abstention: Only on insufficient extraction (<2 roles or 0 relations)

comparison_to_661_arms.gap_analysis: ARN lacks: (1) semantic extraction (dependency parsing, typing), (2) abstraction hierarchy, (3) typed licence, (4) principled abstention. C1 in #661 addresses typed licence and abstention, but still lacks multi-level abstraction (item 3 in this issue).
